event_text: President Fulbert Youlou is overthrown in the Republic of the Congo, after a three-day uprising in the capital.
headline: Congo Coup Ousts President Youlou
story: Barry adjusted his wing, gazing down at the chaos below. 'Seems President Fulbert Youlou's time is up, Susan. Three-day uprising in Brazzaville, and the man's out. His regime wasn't exactly... enlightened. Nationalized industries, restricted civil liberties – the usual.' Susan pecked at a stray crumb. 'Not that the people had much to begin with. He did try to balance the budget, in all fairness. Though, largely on the backs of the poor and the unions.' Barry snorted. 'Yes, that tends to endear one to the population. The labour unions, in particular, were at the forefront of the protests. Youlou's attempts to suppress them only added fuel to the fire.' Susan cocked her head. 'Now, the Congo's got a power vacuum. Always a recipe for stability, I'm sure.' Barry took off, soaring above the rooftops. 'The country's first president, out after just three years. I suppose it's a start, in a manner of speaking.'
regret_line: Looks like Youlou should have invested in a better union-busting strategy, or a parachute.
winner_line: The cycle of instability, it seems, was the real victor in this one.
